messages.text:
"Create a high-quality 3D action RPG game for Android inspired by Black Myth: Wukong.

GAME TITLE: LEGEND OF THE MONKEY KING

GRAPHICS:

- Unreal Engine 5-quality visuals.
- Realistic 3D environments.
- Detailed character models and animations.
- Ancient Chinese mythology atmosphere.
- Beautiful forests, mountains, temples, caves and demon kingdoms.
- Cinematic lighting, shadows, fog and particle effects.
- Third-person camera.

MAIN CHARACTER:
A powerful Monkey King inspired by Sun Wukong.

- Golden magical staff.
- Red and golden ancient warrior armor.
- Monkey-like facial features.
- Long tail.
- Fast and acrobatic movements.

COMBAT SYSTEM:
Create fast, fluid, responsive combat inspired by Black Myth: Wukong.

Include:

1. Light staff attacks.
2. Heavy staff attacks.
3. Staff spinning combos.
4. Jump attacks.
5. Aerial combos.
6. Dodging and perfect dodging.
7. Counterattacks.
8. Charged heavy attacks.
9. Powerful finishing moves.
10. Magical abilities.
11. Boss-specific cinematic executions.

SPECIAL ABILITIES:

- Cloud Somersault: Fly quickly on a magical cloud.
- Immobilize: Freeze enemies temporarily.
- Clone Technique: Summon multiple monkey clones.
- Staff Transformation: Change staff size.
- Shadow Strike: Teleport behind enemies.
- Monkey Transformation: Transform into powerful creatures.

BOSS BATTLES:
Create challenging bosses with unique attack patterns, multiple phases, health bars and cinematic introductions.

BOSSES:

1. Black Wind King – Giant black bear demon.
2. Whiteclad Noble – Fast snake warrior.
3. Tiger Vanguard – Powerful sword-wielding tiger.
4. Yellow Wind Sage – Giant rat demon with wind magic.
5. Red Loong – Lightning dragon.
6. Black Loong – Thunder dragon.
7. Hundred-Eyed Daoist – Giant spider-like demon.
8. Yellowbrow – Powerful golden demon.
9. Erlang Shen – Legendary celestial warrior.
10. The Great Sage's Broken Shell – Final legendary boss.

BOSS MECHANICS:

- Each boss has at least 2 combat phases.
- Different attack patterns.
- Special finishing animations.
- Unique weaknesses.
- Cinematic boss entrances.
- Epic background music.

GAME WORLD:
Create an open-world environment with:

- Ancient Chinese villages.
- Bamboo forests.
- Snowy mountains.
- Haunted temples.
- Underground demon caves.
- Heavenly palaces.
- Hidden boss arenas.

ANDROID CONTROLS:

- Virtual joystick on left.
- Attack button.
- Heavy attack button.
- Dodge button.
- Jump button.
- Magic ability buttons.
- Lock-on target button.
- Transformation button.

GAME FEATURES:

- Offline single-player mode.
- Story campaign.
- Character upgrades.
- Skill tree.
- Weapon upgrades.
- Boss rewards.
- Hidden treasures.
- Secret bosses.
- Save and load system.

ANDROID OPTIMIZATION:

- 30 FPS on low-end devices.
- 60 FPS on supported devices.
- Low, Medium, High and Ultra graphics settings.
- Adjustable resolution.
- Optimized textures and shadows.
- Touchscreen-friendly UI.
- Android APK export.

IMPORTANT:
Do not create a simple fighting demo. Create an actual playable third-person action RPG with working combat, enemy AI, boss battles, exploration, missions, progression and a complete game loop.

---
This is a build request. Build a complete, playable game now (or apply the requested change to the existing game). Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and note them briefly when you finish.

Screenshots for your own checks: save small JPEGs (a .jpg path, viewport at most 1280px wide) and read only the latest one; older images are dropped from context. Read a full-size PNG only when fine detail matters.
"

- Mythic Chinese-inspired world, Monkey King hero, staff combat and special abilities, ten named bosses, and campaign progression.

- Mobile performance settings targeting 30 FPS on low-end and 60 FPS on supported devices; adjustable quality/resolution.

- Implemented as a browser-based Three.js/Vite game, since the repository had no existing game implementation or engine project.
- Created a stylized procedural 3D world and character rather than sourcing external models/assets.

## Objective
- Build “LEGEND OF THE MONKEY KING,” a complete playable third-person action RPG for Android, inspired by Black Myth: Wukong.
- Implement a real exploration, combat, boss, mission, and progression loop rather than a simple fighting demo.

## Requirements
- Mythic Chinese-inspired world, Monkey King hero, staff combat and special abilities, ten named bosses, campaign progression, upgrades, rewards, and save/load.
- Mobile touch controls and desktop controls; offline single-player.
- Low/Medium/High/Ultra settings, adjustable render scale, and Android-friendly performance.
- Build now without clarification; note assumptions on completion.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Implement as a browser-based Three.js/Vite game because the repository had no existing game implementation or engine project.
- Use stylized procedural 3D models and environments instead of external assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Added Vite project manifest and game page with HUD, title/menu/settings/victory overlays, minimap, and desktop/mobile controls.
- Added responsive interface styling.
- Implemented procedural Three.js terrain, grove, path, shrine, gate, lanterns, motes, hero, and enemy/boss meshes.
- Implemented combat, abilities, enemy AI, ten boss definitions, phase transitions, rewards/progression, and localStorage persistence.
- Added world-region and quest/minimap updates.
- Appended keyboard/touch input, menu/settings/victory actions, movement, camera, update/render loop, shrine interaction, upgrades, and quality controls to `src/main.js`.

### Active
- Validate and refine runtime/gameplay, especially boss progression and campaign regions.
- Run production build and browser checks; fix errors and capture/inspect the latest small JPEG screenshot.
- Check `git status` and report assumptions and verification results; changes are uncommitted.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect/fix boss defeat continuation: `defeatBoss()` does not advance `state.bossIndex`, so the next boss/region quest progression appears stuck.
2. Run `npm run build`, launch the game in a browser, exercise controls and progression, and fix runtime or UI issues.
3. Save and inspect a small JPEG screenshot, then check `git status` and summarize assumptions and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Procedural game, combat/progression, UI/event wiring, and render loop.
- `src/style.css`: HUD, overlays, and desktop/mobile responsive styling.
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, overlays, settings, and controls.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.
- `README.md`: Existing project description.

## Important Context
- `npm install` completed successfully; 14 packages added and audit reported 0 vulnerabilities.
- A selector helper issue in `setRegion()` was corrected to use `document.querySelector()` for class selectors.
- The latest `src/main.js` wiring was appended, but build and browser verification have not been run.
- `defeatBoss()` records the defeated boss but does not increment `state.bossIndex`; inspect/fix before validating later campaign bosses.

## Objective
- Build and validate “LEGEND OF THE MONKEY KING,” a playable third-person action RPG with exploration, combat, boss progression, upgrades, and save/load.

## Requirements
- Mythic Chinese-inspired world, Monkey King hero, staff combat, special abilities, ten named bosses, campaign progression, rewards, upgrades, and persistence.
- Mobile touch and desktop controls; offline single-player.
- Low/Medium/High/Ultra settings, adjustable render scale, Android-friendly performance.
- Save small JPEG screenshots for checks and inspect only the latest.

## Decisions
- Use Three.js/Vite with procedural models and environments rather than external assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Implemented game shell/HUD, responsive styling, procedural world and characters, combat, boss encounters, progression, settings, and localStorage persistence.
- Fixed CSS parsing failure in `src/style.css`; `npm run build` succeeds.
- Fixed boss progression to increment `state.bossIndex` on defeat and allow the completed-campaign index when loading saves.
- Launched the game in Chromium; start screen, HUD, settings overlay, movement, and no recent browser exceptions were checked.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/latest-game.jpg`.

### Active
- Diagnose browser movement and combat interaction: movement works but is far slower than intended; boss combat has not been demonstrated.
- Investigate very low browser rendering performance and determine whether it is caused by the test environment.
- Validate defeat/continue progression, save/load, and desktop/mobile controls.
- Run final checks and review repository status.

### Blocked
- Browser testing cannot verify boss attacks or progression until the hero reliably reaches and can engage the boss.

## Next Move
1. Diagnose the movement distance discrepancy and improve or isolate the browser performance issue.
2. With reliable movement, reach the first boss and test attacks, defeat/continue progression, and persistence.
3. Verify desktop/mobile controls, run final build and diff checks, inspect repository status, and report results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: Three.js world, gameplay, boss progression, controls, quality settings, and persistence.
- `src/style.css`: HUD, overlays, and responsive styling.
- `index.html`: Game shell, HUD, overlays, and control elements.
- `package.json`: Vite scripts and Three.js dependency.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted; `git status --short` shows project files as untracked, including `dist/`.
- `npm run build`, `node --check src/main.js`, and `git diff --check` previously succeeded; build warns the JavaScript chunk is 508.27 kB (>500 kB).
- Vite is available at `http://127.0.0.1:5173/`; Chromium remote debugging is at port `9222`.
- Holding W for roughly 8 seconds only reduced quest distance from 25 m to 22 m; after more movement it reached about 21 m, despite `updateMovement()` applying speed `4.1 * dt`.
- Heavy attacks and lock-on did not lower boss health in browser testing; boss defeat and progression remain unverified.
- Browser frame-rate probe measured about 2 FPS at default Medium and 2.6 FPS at Low. Chromium was launched with `--disable-gpu`, using SwiftShader WebGL; this likely limits the value of the performance result.
- Current browser canvas is 832×427 at pixel ratio 1; reported WebGL renderer is `WebKit WebGL`.
